podcast.body: This song was Crazy Town's massive hit in 2001, reaching number one on several charts, including the Billboard Hot 100, and charting top 10 in Canada, the UK, and Australia. It sold over a million copies and was one of the first one-hit wonders of the 2000s. The song was based on a sample from the Red Hot Chili Peppers' track "Pretty Little Ditty," leading to all four members of the Chili Peppers receiving songwriting credit.
